children: Developed market sovereign bond yields are close to multi-year highs, making them increasingly more appealing than their corporate bond peers, Societe Generale's Juan Valencia says in a note. Sovereign bonds are perceived as safer assets compared to corporate bonds, as the latter face a higher risk of getting a rating downgrade or defaulting when bond yields are high, Valencia says. Elevated government bond yields could spark a migration from corporate bonds to government bonds, he says. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
